summary.text: David Dewar is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Mary Gill.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

paragraphs.text: David Dewar ran in the 2019 nonpartisan general election for Chicago City Council, Ward 19, and lost to incumbent Matthew O'Shea, receiving 14.8 percent of the vote.
